analysis_options.stepping_protocol: breakpoint on every leaf Action (break_start only; spec v1.2.2 D9: BREAK_ACTION is not part of the v1 enumeration); perform/resume loop; one @BEGIN/@END pair per perform() call of the node, so a rule_repeatapply leaf (ActionPool oppool1/oppool2/cleanup, and non-pool repeatapply leaves such as donothing) emits ONE event covering its whole internal convergence loop (@END count = converged per-perform accumulator, apply = internal changed-apply increments); @SNAP follows every @END; group events nest per spec v1.1 (iii): group @BEGIN before child events, group @END only after the group resumes and completes
analysis_options.restart_policy: single ActionRestartGroup universal (maxrestarts=1); @RESTART emitted on curstart change (native 0-based), first round suppressed; root event stays open across restarts and ends at final completion with accumulated count
analysis_options.observation_hack: Action protected fields read via explicit access macro include wrapper; ActionRestartGroup::curstart read through instrumented accessor fixtureGetCurstart (precedent action_break_pool_1204.cc:561); SleighArchitecture languageindex/description (implicitly private, no access label) read through instrumented public accessors fixtureGetLanguageIndex/fixtureGetLanguage so META arch/cspec are DERIVED from the live conf object (LanguageDescription id + resolved CompilerTag id; x86.ldefs language id=x86:LE:64:default, compiler tag id=gcc — x86-64-gcc is the spec file name, not the id)
analysis_options.normalization: pointer-valued varnodes only: s:<spacename> for spaceid constants (live AddrSpace object address table, sleigh.cc:236/269), f:<call op seqnum> for fspec-space varnodes (Funcdata::newVarnodeCallSpecs), o:<referenced op seqnum> for iop-space varnodes (Funcdata::newVarnodeIop); unique offsets NOT normalized; ratified as spec v1.2 addendum (docs/alignment_docs/STAGE_BISECT_SPEC_1204.md, master a31a3cb)

input.initial_state: fresh Funcdata via followFlow over full default code space; production universal action tree reset

projection_expectations.determinism: byte-identical across repeated runs on the producing host with ASLR enabled

descriptor_grammar: spec v1.2.1 grammar: v1.1 base + ratified s:/f:/o: pointer pseudonyms (v1.2 addendum, master a31a3cb) + opcode domain = get_opname(op->code()) verbatim (opcodes.hh:133 canonical 74-name uppercase table, master 85d78a7 erratum: the typeop.cc name domain is lossy, e.g. INT_LESS/INT_SLESS both render '<'); runner validator enforces the closed cpui name table with token shape ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$ via the data-driven OPCODE_DOMAIN constant
